title: The Scholz–Brauer addition-chain conjecture
formal: For every positive integer n, does ℓ(2ⁿ−1)≤n−1+ℓ(n), where ℓ(a) is the minimum number of additions in an addition chain from 1 to a?
context:
The inequality is the target; equality for every n is a stronger statement and is not asserted.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A longstanding structural question about the multiplication cost of exponentiation.
